title: Comparação pareada de oito metaheurísticas e dois híbridos
stop_rule: fixed evaluator budget; no target early stop
budget: Every full evaluator invocation charged, including repeated candidates, context retests, diversity, offspring, line searches, paired controls and revalidation of dormant own-arm sources. Only one final independent audit is additional.
cost_accounting: Actual AC cases, local CPU, wall time, LP count/time, model wait/usage and source revalidation counts reported separately. Equal evaluator budget is not equal wall time, cloud compute or monetary cost.
physical_policy: All original strict constraints from initialization; no relaxed SAIDI/SAIFI phase for any method.
objective: PC1 + (1-beta)*expected annual operation + beta*CVaR_alpha annual operation

starts_description.1: Same frozen original MAT eight-member population for every method and seed
starts_description.2: Same frozen original auxiliary-heuristic population, with declared copies, for every method and seed. Historical preparation cost excluded equally from conditional comparison.

native: Original full resource agenda, persistent native memories, original parameters; no auxiliary optimizer during native trials.
hybrid: Current rolling_review_v2 and CompleteKernel reused; independent cycle/cases alternation and frequent review retained; no candidate import from campaigns.
AI: Authenticated autonomous Codex, no tools or file access, observations restricted to own trial; model/usage captured. Seed controls algorithmic randomness; language model is not guaranteed deterministic.
failures: Recorded as failures; no silent fallback, substituted AI, repeated trials or extra evaluations.
smoke: Separate, excluded from comparisons: 40 calls per native method and 88 per hybrid; then production at the common 4104-call budget.
analysis: Pair within start/beta/seed. Report feasible fraction, median and IQR among feasible finals, paired win/tie/loss, convergence by charged evaluations and actual work. Do not pool beta/starts as replicates.
model_failure_policy: At most three inference/plan failures per trial; then fail explicitly. No synthetic AI fallback and no rerun of a failed trial.
